description: This Java class implements metrics collection using Micrometer for the Eclipse Hono project. It tracks connections, message payloads, and tenant timeouts, and interacts with Vert.x event bus for tenant timeout handling.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedMetrics
classes.description: Implements metrics collection and tenant timeout handling for Eclipse Hono using Micrometer and Vert.x.

methods.name: setProtocolAdapterProperties
methods.description: Sets configuration properties, particularly tenant idle timeout.

methods.name: incrementConnections
methods.description: Increments the count of authenticated connections for a tenant.

methods.name: decrementConnections
methods.description: Decrements the count of authenticated connections for a tenant.

methods.name: incrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Increments the count of unauthenticated connections.

methods.name: decrementUnauthenticatedConnections
methods.description: Decrements the count of unauthenticated connections.

methods.name: getNumberOfConnections
methods.description: Returns the total current number of connections.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a new timer for telemetry measurement.

methods.name: reportTelemetry
methods.description: Reports telemetry data for messages or events, including timing and payload size.

methods.name: calculatePayloadSize
methods.description: Calculates payload size considering tenant-specific minimum message size.

methods.name: updateLastSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the last seen timestamp for a tenant and initiates timeout timer if needed.

methods.name: newTenantTimeoutTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to handle tenant timeout based on last activity.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a tenant currently has active connections.

methods.name: handleTenantTimeout
methods.description: Handles cleanup and notification when a tenant times out due to inactivity.
